olivia_acme: Hi team — in the middle of a pilot using Redwood JS SDK streaming + tool calls. Two blockers: (1) our backend expects a top-level `customer` object (v1 schema) but SDK tool calls come wrapped like `tool_response.result.customer`. (2) we need pricing for a pilot: target 10 rps sustained, bursts to 60 rps. Also SSO + KMS questions from security.

tess_sales: Thanks — looping in Kai (SDK) and Pat (platform). We can do a quick pairing tomorrow.

kai_dev: Quick note: you can ask the SDK to emit structured payloads directly. In the stream call set `structured_output_v1: true` and use `tool_call_mode: 'pass_args'`. Example: ```js
await client.chat.stream({
  model: 'redwood-chat-1',
  structured_output_v1: true,
  tool_call_mode: 'pass_args',
  tools: [lookupCustomer]
});
```

kai_dev: That should produce { "customer": { ... } } as the top-level structured output. If you can't change the call now, add a tiny client-side unwrap middleware: ```js
client.on('tool_called', msg => {
  if (msg.tool_response?.result?.customer) return msg.tool_response.result.customer;
  return msg;
});
```

pat_platform: KMS note: BYOK/HSM is available for Private and Dedicated only. For Hosted pilots we offer managed keys with attestations; can discuss an addendum for tighter controls. IP allowlist + SSO: Hosted supports org-level SSO and we can gate IP ranges via a contract change.

pat_platform: Fallbacks if reserved capacity is depleted: you can configure `fallback: 'graceful'` to route overflow to a hosted small model or serve cached prefix responses. Example policy snippet: 
```yaml
routes:
  - name: acme-pilot
    primary: dedicated/acme-pilot
    fallback: hosted-small
    fallback_behavior: graceful
```

sam_security: From security: we'll need SAML flow docs (SP-initiated), SCIM provisioning details, encryption at rest/in transit, and proof of audit logs for the PoC. I'll send a short checklist and sample artifacts.

tess_sales: Action items: 1) Kai to pair with Olivia tomorrow 09:30 PT (https://meet.redwood.internal/pilot-debug) 2) Pat to confirm KMS options and contract path 3) Sam to send security checklist 4) Sales to get preliminary pilot pricing estimate.

infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-20 12:11 UTC: feature flag `structured_output_experiment` enabled for alpha orgs.

olivia_acme: Great — pairing confirmed. We'll try `structured_output_v1` first and use the unwrap middleware as fallback. Please add me to the presales ticket. Thanks! :thumbsup:
